title: WILDBENCH: BENCHMARKING LLMS WITH CHALLENGING TASKS FROM REAL USERS IN THE WILD

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLM judges disproportionately favor longer responses by analyzing output lengths relative to leaderboard rankings, and mitigating this by implementing a character-length threshold (margin for ties) that converts 'slight wins' to 'ties' when the winning response is significantly longer.

Using task-specific evaluation checklists synthesized from multiple distinct LLMs (GPT-4-Turbo and Claude-3-Opus) and conducting pairwise comparisons against three different baseline models to prevent the LLM judge from merely favoring its own generated outputs or specific stylistic preferences.
